facts.fact: 苏齐是遛狗师，业余在 Marlow FM 电台每周主持一次宠物电话节目
facts.anchor: Suzie was a dog-walker who had a sideline presenting a phone-in programme about pets

facts.fact: 前一晚苏齐与朱迪思、贝克斯一起抓到了凶手
facts.anchor: along with her friends Judith and Becks, she’d helped catch a killer

facts.fact: 三个女人在《不可 Importance of Being Earnest》演出中抓到凶手，这种事不常有
facts.anchor: how many times have three women caught a killer in the middle of a performance of The Importance of Being Earnest?

facts.fact: 电视头条是哈莱福德勋爵因“现金换问题”丑闻退出上议院席位
facts.anchor: Lord Harleyford has announced he’s giving up his seat in the House of Lords

facts.fact: 贝克斯是马洛教区牧师的妻子
facts.anchor: Becks was the wife of the vicar of Marlow

facts.fact: 贝克斯与苏齐在同一时间各自收到短信
facts.anchor: At the same time that Becks and Suzie were receiving their texts

facts.fact: 凌晨三点朱迪思放弃入睡，转去摆弄一幅德文郡伯尔岛千片拼图
facts.anchor: turned her attention to the thousand-piece jigsaw of Burgh Island in Devon

facts.fact: 储物间里那只小皮箱是朱迪思连自己都不告诉的秘密
facts.anchor: the case in the box room was the secret she kept even from herself

facts.fact: 门外站着警督塔妮卡·马利克，她来得不是时候
facts.anchor: Detective Inspector Tanika Malik was standing outside in a dark blue puffer jacket

facts.fact: 朱迪思试探她是否为奥利弗·贝雷斯福德案而来
facts.anchor: I suppose you’re here about the Oliver Beresford case?

facts.fact: 马利克从未听说过艾勒尼这个名字
facts.anchor: I’ve not heard that name before. Who is she?

facts.fact: 昨晚足球运动员加里·怀斯在自家屋后的林子里中枪身亡，一颗子弹穿心
facts.anchor: he went into the woods behind his house and was shot dead – a single bullet through the heart
